Base = release v0.1.4 ini defaults ([RouteAsync] Enabled/Mode 1 Kinds 0, [RouteGate] Enabled/Sites/Enforce 1, [Discourage] Enabled 1; RouteSnap off, P5c FreeLock off: P5c is parked and not in v0.2.0, so the A/B measures the release setup) plus LogFallbackStack=16 (docs/141), HitchAttr on, BP 10 min, --ab destroypark (dpMode +0x31E0) 2-min slices, warm-up then off,on,on,off (ABBA). asi = game-copy/ts3native.asi.0313 (ts3native 0.36.13 merge build). Target key 0x2000003 (RT_DESTROY job wait, ~7-11 ms/s BP, docs/88 §4, docs/136): P5c off, so every destroy during a job waits today; those park in the on slices. Expected [inferred]: key near 0 in the on slices except kept waits (dpKeptWait: D-X records, full, off sim, not found), net 3-6 ms/s BP / 1-3 ms/s IP less keyed wait (gains do not add: part may reappear at the next routing touch). Pass: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, dpReady 1, dpParked > 0, T-G1 p5cCountLow 0, T-G3 p5cAgeMaxUs < 100000, p5cFlushed within 512 of p5cParked at the end, vfRtDestroyOffSim 0; read node tools/harness/wait-ab.ts <tag> (0x2000003 on vs off, all keyed waits not higher) and hitch-attr-report.ts. Any crash in 0x939xxx/0x935xxx/0x64xxxx stops the queue (crash-cause rule). Stuck Sims: log only.
